# watch_ui_pages — concrete pages
#   carousel : time(home) / sport / health / functions / tools
#   modals   : settings / clock / timeset / developer / wifi / games / calc
#   games    : dino (sprites are generated by tools/gen_dino_sprites.py) / 2048
# No ESP-IDF dependency: compiles in the PC simulator too.
# NOTE: CMake does NOT support backslash line continuation, keep the list on one line.
idf_component_register(
    SRCS "pages/watch_page_home.c" "pages/watch_page_sport.c" "pages/watch_page_health.c" "pages/watch_page_functions.c" "pages/watch_page_tools.c" "pages/watch_page_settings.c" "pages/watch_page_clock.c" "pages/watch_page_timeset.c" "pages/watch_page_developer.c" "pages/watch_page_wifi.c" "pages/watch_page_games.c" "pages/watch_page_calc.c" "pages/watch_page_calendar.c" "pages/watch_page_weather.c" "pages/watch_page_weather_city.c" "games/dino_game.c" "games/dino_sprites.c" "games/game_2048.c" "watch_pages_all.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include" "games"
    REQUIRES lvgl ui_port watch_ui
)
